task_transaction_status_summary.name: Task Transactions Status Summary
task_transaction_status_summary.query: SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(CAST(task_transaction.status AS CHAR)) IN ('0', 'open', 'pending') THEN 'Open' WHEN LOWER(CAST(task_transaction.status AS CHAR)) IN ('1', 'in progress', 'in_progress') THEN 'In Progress' WHEN LOWER(CAST(task_transaction.status AS CHAR)) IN ('2', 'done', 'completed') THEN 'Done' ELSE CAST(task_transaction.status AS CHAR) END AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM task_transaction WHERE task_transaction.company_id = {company_id} GROUP BY CASE WHEN LOWER(CAST(task_transaction.status AS CHAR)) IN ('0', 'open', 'pending') THEN 'Open' WHEN LOWER(CAST(task_transaction.status AS CHAR)) IN ('1', 'in progress', 'in_progress') THEN 'In Progress' WHEN LOWER(CAST(task_transaction.status AS CHAR)) IN ('2', 'done', 'completed') THEN 'Done' ELSE CAST(task_transaction.status AS CHAR) END ORDER BY count DESC;
